g.text: Down Home Creole · Phase 1 · P1-304 Drum-top vibratory sifter (built in house) · rev B
Product contact: 2B sheet, #4 polish Ra ≤ 0.8 µm [32 µin]; welds ground flush; passivate ASTM A967 (inside)
UNLESS NOTED: LINEAR ±0.5 [±.02] · HOLES +0.2/-0 · ANGLES ±0.5° · MACHINED X.X ±0.1, X.XX ±0.05 · THIRD-ANGLE PROJECTION · BREAK EDGES 0.5 · ASME Y14.5
Ø9 THRU on R315 [12.402]; bond Ø9 at 90° (R333)

svg.text: inside: seal + grind R1; outside fillet 3
Ledge to shell, top and underside
top fillet 2 ground R1; underside seal (no crevice)
Magnet bars to shell, all round
ends saddle-fitted, seal all round, ground
fillet 4 both sides; leg undersides coplanar 0.5
fillet 3 both sides; top at flange underside
1. Order: roll + seam the shell, weld the flange (A), then ledge and bars, then the outside brackets. Check round ±1 and A flat 0.5 after each step.
2. Isolator bracket undersides coplanar 0.5 and ∥ A 0.5: shim on the fixture, the body must sit level on 3 isolators.
3. Vibrator plate face ⟂ A 0.5 and on the 0° line ±1: the motor axis must be vertical.
